C2.2.quote: has to vote on whether to accept or reject an issue
C2.2.note: Inputs are binary votes on one issue plus a delegation profile (a map from agents to agents or abstention). Agents also have weights.

C2.3.note: Agents have accuracies q_i and utilities combining power and accuracy. These are defined separately from their delegation choices.

C2.4.note: Delegations are strategies with their own notation, separate from utilities and accuracies.

C3.1.note: The power-index axiomatics take delegation profiles as given. The delegation game and the simulations are strategic.

C5.1.note: Results evaluate the distribution of power (average DB, Gini coefficient) and the ratio of delegators. No listed welfare, efficiency or representation criterion is used.
